newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 1.

text.p: New England Electric System said it agreed to divest its generating business as part of a state plan to foster competition in Massachusetts. New England Electric closed at 31-1/8.
* Xilinx said it expects its second quarter revenues and income to fall short of first quarter levels. Shares closed at 34.
* HCIA Inc said its third and fourth quarter earnings would be below analysts' estimates. The company also announced a third quarter charge. Shares closed at 60.
* WHX Corp said workers at its Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel Corp unit went on strike at eight facilities after failure to reach agreement on a new contract. Shares closed at 10.
* American Eagle Group said it was exiting the local haul business and planned to discontinue the dividend on its common shares. Shares closed at 4-1/4.

* IVAX Corp said it expected to post a third quarter operating loss of $35 million, excluding a $13 million restructuring charge. The company said it will close two facilities. Shares closed at 16-1/4.
* Chrysler Corp and BMW said they formed a joint venture to build four-cylinder engines in Latin America. Chrysler closed at 28-5/8.
